[[Vloxen Excavations]] | henchman = y | pic1 = [[File:Olafstead-to-Umbral_Grotto.jpg|200px]] | merchant = y | storage = y }} {{Quotation|game|Tucked between the dark granite of the mountain fastness, the Umbral Grotto is a lurking place for those who wish to keep their activities shrouded in shadow. The caverns beneath are overrun with [[Stone Summit]] [[Dwarf|Dwarves]] from the [[southern Shiverpeaks]], making the grotto a dangerous place to wander.}} This area functions as a lobby for staging organized expeditions into nearby [[Slavers' Exile]]. ==Getting there== From [[Olafstead]], go southwest through [[Varajar Fells]] and into [[Verdant Cascades]]. Continue westwards from the portal. [[Umbral Grotto]] can be found in the northwest corner of this area. The primary quest [[The Knowledgeable Asura]] will also lead you through this outpost.
